page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused cloud instance managed under a KVM hypervisor. It is powered by 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs backed by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system includes 96.0 GB of RAM, allocating 4.0 GB of memory per core.

A prominent specification of this server is its vast bundled local storage, featuring 70,866 GB of local HDD capacity. Network connectivity is configured with an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth, though it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance relies on traditional rotational magnetic storage rather than solid-state drives, prioritizing dense storage capacity over low-latency random input/output operations.

Given the massive volume of magnetic storage coupled with 24 dedicated vCPUs, the ecs.d1.6xlarge instance is structured for distributed big data processing, log analytics, Hadoop clusters, and sequential data warehousing where high-density local storage is required.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a high-density storage instance designed on x86_64 architecture and virtualized via KVM. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors clocked at 2.5 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory. A key physical attribute of this server is its bundled 70,866 GB local HDD storage capacity, along with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system does not include dedicated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because it utilizes traditional hard disk drives, it offers high storage density per core at the trade-off of higher random access latency compared to solid-state storage. This instance configuration is suitable for big data analytical pipelines, distributed file systems, and bulk logging workloads.
